claim: All provided energy and weather files cover 8760 hourly records in 2014 with no missing hours.
The 10 building nodes sum exactly/numerically to CN01 and Total for all five energy/emission variables.
Total weather can be joined one-to-one with Total energy at hourly resolution.
Temperature is strongly associated with cooling/electricity seasonality in the mini dataset.
The mini dataset is a compact 2014 subset, not the full 11,987,328-record 2014-2022 HEEW release.
